===== isolate only =====
block v30 slot Some(1): 5 ops, GND#3 .. D#1, travel 68.117 mm, plan 2f2054ca2d22226f
note: Set the work origin 5mm from the board in X and 5mm in Y — your 5mm / 5mm work clearance plus the room this job's cuts outside the board need. Nothing is machined nearer the zero than the clearance.
note: KiCad's stackup states no copper thickness for this face, so 0.035mm (1 oz) was assumed. The isolation depth is that plus the substrate penetration, and the channel width follows from it — set the stackup if the board is not 1 oz.
